simple.summary: זָמִיר (zâmîyr) means a twig (as pruned) First listed occurrence: Song 2 12.

definitions.full: H2159. zamir II. זָמִיר noun [masculine] trimming, pruning (compare Lg BN 173 ) — only הַזָּמִיר עַת Song 2:12 (> others singing ). — I. זמיר see below I. זמר above
